features.featureTitle: Convert all user-facing text throughout the website to English. This includes all headings, subheadings, taglines, button labels, section titles, card text, placeholder text, error messages, and any other visible copy in every component (HeroSection, ServicesSection, AboutSection, ContactSection, FAQSection, FeedbackSection, HowItWorksSection, TrustStatsBar, Header, NavigationDrawer, Footer, ScrollLoginPopup, ScrollRatingPopup, ProfileModal, FloatingCallButton, FloatingWhatsAppButton). Replace any Hindi, mixed-language, or non-English text with clear English equivalents that preserve the original meaning and tone.

Enhance the visual design by mixing white accents into the existing dark theme to make the website more attractive and visually distinct. Apply the following changes across all components: (1) Service cards, feedback review cards, FAQ accordion items, HowItWorksSection step cards, and ContactSection info cards should use white or off-white card backgrounds (e.g., #ffffff or rgba(255,255,255,0.06)–0.10) with dark text, creating a contrast against the dark page background; (2) Add white/light-tinted section dividers or subtle white borders between major sections; (3) TrustStatsBar and HowItWorksSection connector lines can use white/light accents; (4) Form inputs in FeedbackSection, ProfileModal, and ScrollRatingPopup should have white or light-bordered inputs; (5) Maintain the existing #FFD700/#FF8C42 accent colors for headings, icons, and CTA buttons — do not replace them; (6) Ensure sufficient contrast: dark text on white card backgrounds, white text on dark section backgrounds; (7) Apply the white card / light accent treatment consistently so the overall effect is a polished dark-and-white mixed theme.
